cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The Agent workflow declares 109 step operations, but the UI can call only model runs (POST /runs), a few data operations and statistical exploration. There is no HTTP route that executes a workflow step without the Agent; the CLI calls WorkflowExecutor directly. Reports can only be created through the AI report route.
impact: User requirement 2026-10-08: every function must work in Workbench alone without a model, and the Agent calls the same functions. Objective step 3 (operation catalog and generated forms) and the manual report in step 8 depend on three interfaces requested from the v1-8-13 line as a contract commit; steps 1, 2 and the independent parts of 4-9 proceed meanwhile.
lesson: An Agent capability with no direct route is a feature the user cannot reach without a model; give every operation one declared execution path and let both the UI and the Agent call it.

cause: Objective step 1: one tokens file (theme/tokens.css) for light and dark; colour literals and undefined colour variables removed; contrast held by test.
impact: Measurement fixed before reporting the drop: CSS colour literals 176 -> 0, TS colour literals 96 -> 0 (52 were in the unused lineage/tokens/tokens.ts, deleted), undefined colour variables 27 -> 0, inline styles 934 (ceiling). The BACKLOG figure of 139 could not be reproduced and is superseded. Browser audit at 1512x982: 0 contrast failures on eight surfaces in light and dark; first pass found four (role badges, React Flow attribution, Ask AI button, bottom panel log text) and they were fixed. V1811-DARK-PANEL-CONTRAST resolved.
lesson: Fallback values in var() hide undefined tokens; forbid colour fallbacks and require every var() to be defined in the tokens file.
